title: PAA → EU AI Act 2026 Compliance Mapping

regulation.name: EU AI Act
regulation.fullTitle: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 of the European Parliament and of the Council

mapping.evidence: PAA does not perform biometric categorization, social scoring, or subliminal manipulation. Edge-only inference.
STA-100 ships as Limited Risk by default. High-Risk classification triggers human-in-the-loop configuration in PAA admin console.
Mandatory human-in-the-loop for any decision affecting data subjects. Built-in approval workflow.
OpenClaw OS quality management system documented, versioned, and continuously improved per ISO/IEC 42001:2023.
STRATRONIX provides deployer documentation including PAA Standard v1.0 white paper and EU AI Act Mapping (this document).
PAA admin console generates FRIA template per deployer use case.
All AI interactions explicitly marked as AI. Watermark metadata in all generated documents.

conclusion: STA-100 PAA meets all relevant requirements of the EU AI Act (Regulation 2024/1689) by design and by configuration.
citation: Wang, J. (2026). STRATRONIX PAA → EU AI Act 2026 Mapping v1.0. STRATRONIX. https://donaldwang6-dev.github.io/stratronix-seo/open-data/eu-ai-act-mapping.json
